text:
Maya: quick proposal — add a tiny preflight compatibility check before the smoke bench to fail fast on tokenizer/ABI/binary shape issues.
Liam: love it. saves bench cycles. what is the minimal check set?
Sofia: minimal = tokenizer id mapping for 5 canonical phrases, kv-cache shape/dtype sanity, and a 1-seq micro-forward to validate shapes and tiny numeric sanity.
Maya: goal: <1s on a warmed sandbox image. token_probe + micro-forward -> enqueue bench only on pass.
Liam: how should we encode failures? boolean is weak. structured reasons + short evidence for analytics.
Sofia: agreed. simple schema: reason_code, component, evidence_snippet (short). e.g., TOKEN_ID_MISMATCH | tokenizer | "id 102 != exp 103". store in model.metadata.
Alex: micro-forward caveat: kernel/runtime differences can produce false negatives. run preflight in the same sandbox image as serving for Dedicated/Private; for hosted, consider kernel-fingerprint emulation.
Priya: operationally we need gate-versioning (semver) and embed gate_version in intake record for reproducibility.
DevOpsBot: deploy note: preflight v1 scheduled on intake-workers pool image=ml-sandbox:v2026-06-01.
Maya: quantized binaries nuance: allow a tolerance enum (lenient/medium/strict) in intake.yaml; default=medium. enterprise can set strict.
Liam: golden compare sketch: deterministic seed -> small random input -> forward -> compare to golden tensor with relative L2 threshold.
Sofia: pseudo:
seed=42; x=randint(seed,(1,16)); out=model.forward(x); if l2(out,golden)/norm(golden)>THRESH -> fail("GOLDEN_DELTA").
Alex: where to keep goldens? small immutable artifacts in blobstore keyed by model-family+gate_version; content-hash for traceability.
Priya: metrics/alerts: entry_gate.fail_rate, alert if >3 failed intakes in 1h. Ops will add dashboards.
Maya: UX: intake API returns early verdict: {status:"queued", entry_gate:{state:"pass"|"fail", reasons:[...], gate_version:"1.0.0"}} and console shows a fast-check badge linking evidence.
Liam: docs & remediation: I'll draft short playbook with common tokenizer fixes and re-run steps.
Sofia: I'll prototype the micro-runner + golden compare and run tests on amd64 + nvidia images (PR by Friday).
Alex: ensure logs redact weights and secrets — only hashes and short evidence snippets.
DevOpsBot: reminder: intake-workers pool maintenance tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC.
Maya: action items recap: Liam=docs+schema (EOD Wed); Sofia=prototype+tests (PR Fri); Alex=tolerance semantics (sync Thu); Priya=gate-versioning+metrics. Thanks. :thumbsup:
